# BouonLab — 防音ナレッジベース（Japan Soundproofing Knowledge Base）

> Practical knowledge base on soundproofing, acoustic treatment, noise reduction, and quiet living in Japan. Covers unit soundproof rooms, DIY acoustic treatment, soundproof rental apartments, financial/subsidy guides, creator environments, and market analysis. All primary content is in Japanese; a small set of English articles is published selectively under Japan-lens categories.

Last updated: 2026-07-10

---

## Primary Locale

- [Japanese (ja)](https://bouon-lab.com/ja/): Primary content; all topics originate here

## English (Japan lens)

English content is not a translation layer. It is published selectively, reframing Japanese soundproofing topics through a "Japan lens" (society, housing market, culture) rather than mirroring the `ja` category structure.

- [Building code reform 2025 and noise insulation](https://bouon-lab.com/en/japan-noise-and-society/building-code-reform-2025-noise-insulation/): How Japan's 2025 building code reform affects noise insulation requirements
- [Cost to soundproof a room in Japan](https://bouon-lab.com/en/japan-quiet-spaces/cost-to-soundproof-a-room-in-japan/): Realistic cost breakdown for soundproofing a room in Japan
- [How Japanese streamers soundproof their rooms](https://bouon-lab.com/en/japan-quiet-spaces/how-japanese-streamers-soundproof/): How VTubers and streamers in Japan handle soundproofing on a budget

---

## URL Structure

`https://bouon-lab.com/{lang}/{category}/{slug}/` (trailing slash required)

- lang: `ja` (primary) or `en` (selective, Japan-lens categories)
- category: one of 8 top-level `ja` categories, or 3 top-level `en` categories
- slug: article-specific identifier

---

## Content Categories (Japanese)

### 防音室 — Soundproof Room (`soundproof-room`)
- [Index](https://bouon-lab.com/ja/soundproof-room/): Unit rooms, installation, product comparison, acoustic design, size selection, maintenance

### 防音賃貸 — Soundproof Rental (`soundproof-rental`)
- [Index](https://bouon-lab.com/ja/soundproof-rental/): Music-friendly apartments, contract checks, renovation ROI for landlords, market data

### DIY防音 — DIY Soundproofing (`diy`)
- [Index](https://bouon-lab.com/ja/diy/): Self-built booths, acoustic panels, bass traps, materials, cost breakdowns, failure patterns

### お金・補助金 — Cost & Subsidies (`money`)
- [Index](https://bouon-lab.com/ja/money/): Pricing, loans, subsidies (airport/road/ZEH), tax strategy, resale/ROI simulation

### 配信・クリエイター — Creators & Streamers (`creator`)
- [Index](https://bouon-lab.com/ja/creator/): VTuber/ASMR/gaming environments, heat management, streaming setup, rental selection

### 防音の基礎知識 — Acoustics Knowledge (`knowledge`)
- [Index](https://bouon-lab.com/ja/knowledge/): D-value, STC, RT60, sound absorption vs insulation, noise regulations, seasonal statistics

### 地域ガイド — Local Guide (`local`)
- [Index](https://bouon-lab.com/ja/local/): City-specific soundproof rental guides for Tokyo, Osaka, Sendai, Kobe, Kyoto, etc.

### 企業・法人向け — Business & Enterprise (`business`)
- [Index](https://bouon-lab.com/ja/business/): Office soundproofing, shared studio market, ESG trends, corporate renovation strategy

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://bouon-lab.com/sitemap-index.xml): Full sitemap index (ja + en)

### Technical Foundation

- Framework: Astro v6 + Starlight + MDX
- Primary locale: `/ja/` (Japanese); selective `/en/` articles under Japan-lens categories
- URL pattern: `/{lang}/{category}/{slug}/` (flat, no subcategory layer)
- 8 top-level `ja` categories: soundproof-room, soundproof-rental, diy, money, creator, knowledge, local, business
- 3 top-level `en` categories (Japan lens): japan-noise-and-society, japan-soundproof-housing, japan-quiet-spaces
- Draft articles (`draft: true`) are excluded from build and sitemap
- All articles include `lang`, `category`, `slug`, `date`, `lastmod`, `tags` in frontmatter
